items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: Susie and I, my wife is my manager by the way

ctx.x: Zuckerman. Muriel Zuckerman. And she called me, I was living in Mount Adams in my bachelor pad, that was before Susie and I, and so one morning about ten o’clock she calls and says, “I’m with Benny Goodman’s office, and we were wondering if you would want to — we’ll send you a ticket and you come out and play a gig with him up in Dearborn, Michigan” I think it was. And I thought at first it was one of these things, you know, I said, “Yeah, yeah, sure.” She said, “I’m serious, I’m serious.” And then I finally…
So in a sense it was an audition.
